item.title: Riverhead seeks public input for hazard mitigation plan update
item.description: Residents and businesses are asked to complete an online survey by Feb. 20 for an update to Suffolk's hazard mitigation plan.

item.title: Police officer promoted to sergeant, hearing held on tax break for volunteer first responders after 2 years of service: Town Board meeting wrap
item.description: The Town Board yesterday promoted Police Officer Matthew Suprina to the rank of sergeant. Here's a rundown of actions taken by the board at its Feb. 3 meeting.

item.title: Suffolk DA: Riverhead man indicted for aggravated vehicular assault in Nov. 29 DWI crash that injured multiple people
item.description: A 22-year-d Riverhead man drove drunk and crashed into two vehicles, one of them head on, injuring five others and himself, the DA said.

item.title: Republicans tap Rothwell for supervisor
item.description: The Riverhead Republican Committee last night voted to run Council Member Ken Rothwell for town supervisor in the November general election.

item.title: Police seek help locating teen missing from Timothy Hill Ranch
item.description: Riverhead Police are asking for the public’s help locating 16-year-old Dante Tullon, who did not return to the Timothy Hill Ranch after arriving at Riverhead High School on Feb. 2, 2026.

item.title: Dangerously cold wind chill values forecast this weekend
item.description: Dangerously cold wind chills as low as 20 degrees below zero are forecast Saturday night into early Sunday morning, according to the National Weather Service.

item.title: Is environmental review to blame for lack of affordable housing in NY? Advocates, elected officials discuss proposed rules changes
item.description: Proposed changes to New York’s State Environmental Quality Review Act, or SEQRA, dominated the discussion during State Sen. Anthony Palumbo’s annual “environmental roundtable” Monday in Riverhead.

item.title: Neighbors voice concerns to Planning Board about 16-lot subdivision in Aquebogue
item.description: The Summerwind Farm subdivision would create 13 single-family lots, two agricultural lots and a recharge basin lot on 30 acres off Peconic Bay Blvd. near Reeves Creek.

item.title: Louis F. Angotti, 81
item.description: Louis F. Angotti of Mattituck died Feb. 3, 2026, at home. He was 81 years old.

item.title: James M. Nunemaker, 76
item.description: James M. Nunemaker of Southold died Feb. 5, 2026, at home. He was 76 years old.
